pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 1): List the major truck lines serving your town.
Field Verification Standard: Apply Truck Transportation Requirement 1 procedures using verifiable measurements, clear terminology, and the BSA EDGE method.

Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing List the major truck lines serving your town.
Execute & Document: Perform the list task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Truck Transportation Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.

requirements.lead_text: Visit a truck terminal and complete items 4(a) through 4(e). After your visit, share what you have learned with your counselor.
requirements.req_text: Visit a truck terminal and complete items 4(a) through 4(e). After your visit, share what you have learned with your counselor. (a) Find out what kind of maintenance program the company follows to help keep its fleet, drivers, and the roadway safe. (b) Find out how dispatchers maintain communication with drivers on the road. (c) Talk with a professional truck driver about safety. Learn about the truck driver's rules of the road for safe driving. List five safe-driving rules every professional truck driver must follow. (d) Review the driver's log and find out what kind of information the log contains. (e) Learn about important federal regulations that help ensure public safety.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 10): Explore careers related to this merit badge.
Core Standard 2 (Req 10): Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties, and career advancement.

Core Standard 3 (Req 10): Your research methods may include, with your parent or guardian's permission, an internet or library search, an interview with a professional in the field, or a visit to a location where people in this career work.
Core Standard 4 (Req 10): Discuss with your counselor both your findings and what about this profession might make it an interesting career.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 10): Review the official Truck Transportation requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Truck Transportation Careers, Training & Hobby Pathways.
Execute & Document: Perform the explore task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Truck Transportation Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
